## MGIT Students Win Prestigious JNTUH Gold Medals

News Date : 02 Jun 2025News ReportWe are proud to announce that five outstanding students from MGIT have been recognized as theBest Outgoing Studentsamong all affiliated colleges of JNTUH in their respective branches for the academic batch 2020-2024:Ms. Pannati Sreeja– B.Tech. Civil EngineeringMr. Gottiparthi Abhinay– B.Tech. Mechanical Engineering (Mechatronics)Ms. Medagam Nikhita Reddy– B.Tech. Metallurgical & Materials EngineeringMs. K Sai Bharathi– B.Tech. Computer Science & Business SystemsMs. P Ayesha Khanam– B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science)Congratulations 🎊 to our proud students and their parents!These students will receive the prestigious Gold Medals from the Hon’ble Governor during the JNTUH convocation ceremony this afternoon.MGIT extends its heartiest congratulations and best wishes for their bright futures ahead!

We are proud to announce that five outstanding students from MGIT have been recognized as theBest Outgoing Studentsamong all affiliated colleges of JNTUH in their respective branches for the academic batch 2020-2024:
- Ms. Pannati Sreeja– B.Tech. Civil Engineering
Ms. Pannati Sreeja– B.Tech. Civil Engineering
- Mr. Gottiparthi Abhinay– B.Tech. Mechanical Engineering (Mechatronics)
Mr. Gottiparthi Abhinay– B.Tech. Mechanical Engineering (Mechatronics)
- Ms. Medagam Nikhita Reddy– B.Tech. Metallurgical & Materials Engineering
Ms. Medagam Nikhita Reddy– B.Tech. Metallurgical & Materials Engineering
- Ms. K Sai Bharathi– B.Tech. Computer Science & Business Systems
Ms. K Sai Bharathi– B.Tech. Computer Science & Business Systems
- Ms. P Ayesha Khanam– B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science)
Ms. P Ayesha Khanam– B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science)
Congratulations 🎊 to our proud students and their parents!
These students will receive the prestigious Gold Medals from the Hon’ble Governor during the JNTUH convocation ceremony this afternoon.
MGIT extends its heartiest congratulations and best wishes for their bright futures ahead!
